ayahs.tl: Haa-Meeem
ayahs.en: Ha, Meem.

ayahs.ar: تَنۡزِيۡلُ الۡكِتٰبِ مِنَ اللّٰهِ الۡعَزِيۡزِ الۡعَلِيۡمِۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Tanzeelul Kitaabi minal laahil Azeezil 'Aleem
ayahs.en: The revelation of the Book is from Allah, the Exalted in Might, the Knowing.

ayahs.ar: غَافِرِ الذَّنۭۡ بِ وَقَابِلِ التَّوۡبِ شَدِيۡدِ الۡعِقَابِ ذِي الطَّوۡلِؕ لَا٘ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا هُوَؕ اِلَيۡهِ الۡمَصِيۡرُ
ayahs.tl: Ghaafiriz zambi wa qaabilit tawbi shadeedil 'iqaabi zit tawli laaa ilaaha illaa Huwa ilaihil maseer
ayahs.en: The forgiver of sin, acceptor of repentance, severe in punishment, owner of abundance. There is no deity except Him; to Him is the destination.

ayahs.ar: مَا يُجَادِلُ فِيۡ٘ اٰيٰتِ اللّٰهِ اِلَّا الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا فَلَا يَغۡرُرۡكَ تَقَلُّبُهُمۡ فِي الۡبِلَادِ
ayahs.tl: Maa yujaadilu feee Aayaatil laahi illal lazeena kafaroo falaa yaghrurka taqallubuhum fil bilaad
ayahs.en: No one disputes concerning the signs of Allah except those who disbelieve, so be not deceived by their [uninhibited] movement throughout the land.

ayahs.ar: كَذَّبَتۡ قَبۡلَهُمۡ قَوۡمُ نُوۡحٍ وَّالۡاَحۡزَابُ مِنۭۡ بَعۡدِهِمۡࣕ وَهَمَّتۡ كُلُّ اُمَّةٍۭ بِرَسُوۡلِهِمۡ لِيَاۡخُذُوۡهُ وَجَادَلُوۡا بِالۡبَاطِلِ لِيُدۡحِضُوۡا بِهِ الۡحَقَّ فَاَخَذۡتُهُمۡࣞ فَكَيۡفَ كَانَ عِقَابِ
ayahs.tl: Kazzabat qablahum qawmu Noohinw wal Ahzaabu mim ba'dihim wa hammat kullu ummatim bi Rasoolihim liyaa khuzoobhu wa jaadaloo bilbaatili liyudhidoo bihil haqqa fa akhaztuhum fakifa kaana 'iqaab
ayahs.en: The people of Noah denied before them and the [disbelieving] factions after them, and every nation intended [a plot] for their messenger to seize him, and they disputed by [using] falsehood to [attempt to] invalidate thereby the truth. So I seized them, and how [terrible] was My penalty.

ayahs.ar: وَكَذٰلِكَ حَقَّتۡ كَلِمَتُ رَبِّكَ عَلَي الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡ٘ا اَنَّهُمۡ اَصۡحٰبُ النَّارِۘؔ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa kazaalika haqqat Kalimatu Rabbika 'alal lazeena kafarooo annahum Ashaabun Naar
ayahs.en: And thus has the word of your Lord come into effect upon those who disbelieved that they are companions of the Fire.

ayahs.ar: اَلَّذِيۡنَ يَحۡمِلُوۡنَ الۡعَرۡشَ وَمَنۡ حَوۡلَهٗ يُسَبِّحُوۡنَ بِحَمۡدِ رَبِّهِمۡ وَيُؤۡمِنُوۡنَ بِهٖ وَيَسۡتَغۡفِرُوۡنَ لِلَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡاۚ رَبَّنَا وَسِعۡتَ كُلَّ شَيۡءٍ رَّحۡمَةً وَّعِلۡمًا فَاغۡفِرۡ لِلَّذِيۡنَ تَابُوۡا وَاتَّبَعُوۡا سَبِيۡلَكَ وَقِهِمۡ عَذَابَ الۡجَحِيۡمِ
ayahs.tl: Allazeena yahmiloonal 'Arsha wa man hawlahoo yusabbihoona bihamdi Rabbihim wa yu'minoona bihee wa yastaghfiroona lillazeena aamanoo Rabbanaa wasi'ta kulla shai'ir rahmantanw wa 'ilman faghfir lillazeena taaboo wattaba'oo sabeelaka wa qihim 'azaabal Jaheem
ayahs.en: Those [angels] who carry the Throne and those around it exalt [Allah] with praise of their Lord and believe in Him and ask forgiveness for those who have believed, [saying], "Our Lord, You have encompassed all things in mercy and knowledge, so forgive those who have repented and followed Your way and protect them from the punishment of Hellfire.

ayahs.ar: رَبَّنَا وَاَدۡخِلۡهُمۡ جَنّٰتِ عَدۡنِ اِۨلَّتِيۡ وَعَدۡتَّهُمۡ وَمَنۡ صَلَحَ مِنۡ اٰبَآئِهِمۡ وَاَزۡوَاجِهِمۡ وَذُرِّيّٰتِهِمۡؕ اِنَّكَ اَنۡتَ الۡعَزِيۡزُ الۡحَكِيۡمُۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Rabbannaa wa adkhilhum Jannaati 'adninil latee wa'attahum wa man salaha min aabaaa'ihim wa azwaajihim wa zurriyyaatihim; innaka Antal 'Azeezul Hakeem
ayahs.en: Our Lord, and admit them to gardens of perpetual residence which You have promised them and whoever was righteous among their fathers, their spouses and their offspring. Indeed, it is You who is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.

ayahs.ar: وَقِهِمُ السَّيِّاٰتِؕ وَمَنۡ تَقِ السَّيِّاٰتِ يَوۡمَئِذٍ فَقَدۡ رَحِمۡتَهٗؕ وَذٰلِكَ هُوَ الۡفَوۡزُ الۡعَظِيۡمُࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa qihimus saiyi-aat; wa man taqis saiyi-aati Yawma'izin faqad rahimtah; wa zaalika huwal fawzul 'azeem
ayahs.en: And protect them from the evil consequences [of their deeds]. And he whom You protect from evil consequences that Day - You will have given him mercy. And that is the great attainment."

ayahs.ar: اِنَّ الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا يُنَادَوۡنَ لَمَقۡتُ اللّٰهِ اَكۡبَرُ مِنۡ مَّقۡتِكُمۡ اَنۡفُسَكُمۡ اِذۡ تُدۡعَوۡنَ اِلَي الۡاِيۡمَانِ فَتَكۡفُرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Innal lazeena kafaroo yunaadawna lamaqtul laahi akbaru mim maqtikum anfusakum iz tud'awna ilal eemaani fatakfuroon
ayahs.en: Indeed, those who disbelieve will be addressed, "The hatred of Allah for you was [even] greater than your hatred of yourselves [this Day in Hell] when you were invited to faith, but you refused."

ayahs.ar: قَالُوۡا رَبَّنَا٘ اَمَتَّنَا اثۡنَتَيۡنِ وَاَحۡيَيۡتَنَا اثۡنَتَيۡنِ فَاعۡتَرَفۡنَا بِذُنُوۡبِنَا فَهَلۡ اِلٰي خُرُوۡجٍ مِّنۡ سَبِيۡلٍ
ayahs.tl: Qaaloo Rabbanaaa amat tanasnataini wa ahyaitanas nataini fa'tarafnaa bizunoo binaa fahal ilaa khuroojim min sabeel
ayahs.en: They will say, "Our Lord, You made us lifeless twice and gave us life twice, and we have confessed our sins. So is there to an exit any way?"

ayahs.ar: ذٰلِكُمۡ بِاَنَّهٗ٘ اِذَا دُعِيَ اللّٰهُ وَحۡدَهٗ كَفَرۡتُمۡۚ وَاِنۡ يُّشۡرَكۡ بِهٖ تُؤۡمِنُوۡاؕ فَالۡحُكۡمُ لِلّٰهِ الۡعَلِيِّ الۡكَبِيۡرِ
ayahs.tl: Zaalikum bi annahooo izaa du'iyal laahu wahdahoo kafartum wa iny yushrak bihee tu'minoo; falhukmu lillaahil 'Aliyyil Kabeer
ayahs.en: [They will be told], "That is because, when Allah was called upon alone, you disbelieved; but if others were associated with Him, you believed. So the judgement is with Allah, the Most High, the Grand."

ayahs.ar: هُوَ الَّذِيۡ يُرِيۡكُمۡ اٰيٰتِهٖ وَيُنَزِّلُ لَكُمۡ مِّنَ السَّمَآءِ رِزۡقًاؕ وَمَا يَتَذَكَّرُ اِلَّا مَنۡ يُّنِيۡبُ
ayahs.tl: Huwal lazee yureekum Aayaatihee wa yunazzilu lakum minas samaaa'i rizqaa; wa maa tatazakkaru illaa mai yuneeb
ayahs.en: It is He who shows you His signs and sends down to you from the sky, provision. But none will remember except he who turns back [in repentance].

ayahs.ar: فَادۡعُوا اللّٰهَ مُخۡلِصِيۡنَ لَهُ الدِّيۡنَ وَلَوۡ كَرِهَ الۡكٰفِرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Fad'ul laaha mukhliseena lahud deena wa law karihal kaafiroon
ayahs.en: So invoke Allah, [being] sincere to Him in religion, although the disbelievers dislike it.

ayahs.ar: رَفِيۡعُ الدَّرَجٰتِ ذُو الۡعَرۡشِۚ يُلۡقِي الرُّوۡحَ مِنۡ اَمۡرِهٖ عَلٰي مَنۡ يَّشَآءُ مِنۡ عِبَادِهٖ لِيُنۡذِرَ يَوۡمَ التَّلَاقِۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Rafee'ud darajaati zul 'Arshi yulqir rooha min amrihee 'alaa mai yashaaa'u min 'ibaadihee liyunzira yawmat talaaq
ayahs.en: [He is] the Exalted above [all] degrees, Owner of the Throne; He places the inspiration of His command upon whom He wills of His servants to warn of the Day of Meeting.

ayahs.ar: يَوۡمَ هُمۡ بَارِزُوۡنَ ࣢ۚ لَا يَخۡفٰي عَلَي اللّٰهِ مِنۡهُمۡ شَيۡءٌؕ لِمَنِ الۡمُلۡكُ الۡيَوۡمَؕ لِلّٰهِ الۡوَاحِدِ الۡقَهَّارِ
ayahs.tl: Yawma hum baarizoona laa yakhfaa 'alal laahi minhum shai; limanil mulkul Yawma lillaahil Waahidil Qahaar
ayahs.en: The Day they come forth nothing concerning them will be concealed from Allah. To whom belongs [all] sovereignty this Day? To Allah, the One, the Prevailing.

ayahs.ar: اَلۡيَوۡمَ تُجۡزٰي كُلُّ نَفۡسٍۭ بِمَا كَسَبَتۡؕ لَا ظُلۡمَ الۡيَوۡمَؕ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ سَرِيۡعُ الۡحِسَابِ
ayahs.tl: Al-Yawma tujzaa kullu nafsim bimaa kasabat; laa zulmal Yawm; innal laaha saree'ul hisaab
ayahs.en: This Day every soul will be recompensed for what it earned. No injustice today! Indeed, Allah is swift in account.

ayahs.ar: وَاَنۡذِرۡهُمۡ يَوۡمَ الۡاٰزِفَةِ اِذِ الۡقُلُوۡبُ لَدَي الۡحَنَاجِرِ كَاظِمِيۡنَ ࣢ؕ مَا لِلظّٰلِمِيۡنَ مِنۡ حَمِيۡمٍ وَّلَا شَفِيۡعٍ يُّطَاعُؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa anzirhum yawmal aazifati izil quloobu ladal hanaajiri kaazimeen; maa lizzaalimeena min hameeminw wa laa shafee'iny-yutaa'
ayahs.en: And warn them, [O Muhammad], of the Approaching Day, when hearts are at the throats, filled [with distress]. For the wrongdoers there will be no devoted friend and no intercessor [who is] obeyed.

ayahs.ar: يَعۡلَمُ خَآئِنَةَ الۡاَعۡيُنِ وَمَا تُخۡفِي الصُّدُوۡرُ
ayahs.tl: Ya'lamu khaaa'inatal a'yuni wa maa tukhfis sudoor
ayahs.en: He knows that which deceives the eyes and what the breasts conceal.

ayahs.ar: وَاللّٰهُ يَقۡضِيۡ بِالۡحَقِّؕ وَالَّذِيۡنَ يَدۡعُوۡنَ مِنۡ دُوۡنِهٖ لَا يَقۡضُوۡنَ بِشَيۡءٍؕ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ هُوَ السَّمِيۡعُ الۡبَصِيۡرُࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Wallaahu yaqdee bilhaqq, wallazeena yad'oona min doonihee laa yaqdoona bishai'; innal laaha Huwas Samee'ul Baseer
ayahs.en: And Allah judges with truth, while those they invoke besides Him judge not with anything. Indeed, Allah - He is the Hearing, the Seeing.

ayahs.ar: اَوَلَمۡ يَسِيۡرُوۡا فِي الۡاَرۡضِ فَيَنۡظُرُوۡا كَيۡفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الَّذِيۡنَ كَانُوۡا مِنۡ قَبۡلِهِمۡؕ كَانُوۡا هُمۡ اَشَدَّ مِنۡهُمۡ قُوَّةً وَّاٰثَارًا فِي الۡاَرۡضِ فَاَخَذَهُمُ اللّٰهُ بِذُنُوۡبِهِمۡؕ وَمَا كَانَ لَهُمۡ مِّنَ اللّٰهِ مِنۡ وَّاقٍ
ayahs.tl: Awalam yaseeroo fil ardi fa yanzuroo kaifa kaana 'aaqibatul lazeena kaanoo min qablihim; kaanoo hum ashadda minhum quwwatanw wa aasaaran fil ardi fa akhazahumul laahu bizunoobihim wa maa kaana lahum minal laahi minw waaq
ayahs.en: Have they not traveled through the land and observed how was the end of those who were before them? They were greater than them in strength and in impression on the land, but Allah seized them for their sins. And they had not from Allah any protector.

ayahs.ar: ذٰلِكَ بِاَنَّهُمۡ كَانَتۡ تَّاۡتِيۡهِمۡ رُسُلُهُمۡ بِالۡبَيِّنٰتِ فَكَفَرُوۡا فَاَخَذَهُمُ اللّٰهُؕ اِنَّهٗ قَوِيٌّ شَدِيۡدُ الۡعِقَابِ
ayahs.tl: Zaalika bi annahum kaanat taateehim Rusuluhum bilbaiyinaati fakafaroo fa akhazahumul laah; innahoo qawiyyun shadeedul 'iqaab
ayahs.en: That was because their messengers were coming to them with clear proofs, but they disbelieved, so Allah seized them. Indeed, He is Powerful and severe in punishment.

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدۡ اَرۡسَلۡنَا مُوۡسٰي بِاٰيٰتِنَا وَسُلۡطٰنٍ مُّبِيۡنٍۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa laqad arsalnaa Moosaa bi Aayaatinaa wa sultaanim mubeen
ayahs.en: And We did certainly send Moses with Our signs and a clear authority

ayahs.ar: اِلٰي فِرۡعَوۡنَ وَهَامٰنَ وَقَارُوۡنَ فَقَالُوۡا سٰحِرٌ كَذَّابٌ
ayahs.tl: Ilaa Fir'awna wa Haamaana qa Qaaroona faqaaloo saahirun kazzaab
ayahs.en: To Pharaoh, Haman and Qarun; but they said, "[He is] a magician and a liar."

ayahs.ar: فَلَمَّا جَآءَهُمۡ بِالۡحَقِّ مِنۡ عِنۡدِنَا قَالُوا اقۡتُلُوۡ٘ا اَبۡنَآءَ الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا مَعَهٗ وَاسۡتَحۡيُوۡا نِسَآءَهُمۡؕ وَمَا كَيۡدُ الۡكٰفِرِيۡنَ اِلَّا فِيۡ ضَلٰلٍ
ayahs.tl: Falamuna jaaa'ahum bil haqqi min 'indinaa qaaluq tulooo abnaaa'al lazeena aamanoo ma'ahoo wastahyoo nisaaa'ahum; wa maa kaidul kaafireena illaa fee dalaal
ayahs.en: And when he brought them the truth from Us, they said, "Kill the sons of those who have believed with him and keep their women alive." But the plan of the disbelievers is not except in error.

ayahs.ar: وَقَالَ فِرۡعَوۡنُ ذَرُوۡنِيۡ٘ اَقۡتُلۡ مُوۡسٰي وَلۡيَدۡعُ رَبَّهٗؕۚ اِنِّيۡ٘ اَخَافُ اَنۡ يُّبَدِّلَ دِيۡنَكُمۡ اَوۡ اَنۡ يُّظۡهِرَ فِي الۡاَرۡضِ الۡفَسَادَ
ayahs.tl: Wa qaala Fir'awnu zarooneee aqtul Moosaa walyad'u Rabbahoo inneee akhaafu ai yubaddila deenakum aw ai yuzhira fil ardil fasaad
ayahs.en: And Pharaoh said, "Let me kill Moses and let him call upon his Lord. Indeed, I fear that he will change your religion or that he will cause corruption in the land."

ayahs.ar: وَقَالَ مُوۡسٰ٘ي اِنِّيۡ عُذۡتُ بِرَبِّيۡ وَرَبِّكُمۡ مِّنۡ كُلِّ مُتَكَبِّرٍ لَّا يُؤۡمِنُ بِيَوۡمِ الۡحِسَابِࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa qaala Moosaaaa innee 'uztu bi Rabbee wa Rabbikum min kulli mutakabbiril laayu'minu bi Yawmil Hisaab
ayahs.en: But Moses said, "Indeed, I have sought refuge in my Lord and your Lord from every arrogant one who does not believe in the Day of Account."

ayahs.ar: وَقَالَ رَجُلٌ مُّؤۡمِنٌࣗۖ مِّنۡ اٰلِ فِرۡعَوۡنَ يَكۡتُمُ اِيۡمَانَهٗ٘ اَتَقۡتُلُوۡنَ رَجُلًا اَنۡ يَّقُوۡلَ رَبِّيَ اللّٰهُ وَقَدۡ جَآءَكُمۡ بِالۡبَيِّنٰتِ مِنۡ رَّبِّكُمۡؕ وَاِنۡ يَّكُ كَاذِبًا فَعَلَيۡهِ كَذِبُهٗۚ وَاِنۡ يَّكُ صَادِقًا يُّصِبۡكُمۡ بَعۡضُ الَّذِيۡ يَعِدُكُمۡؕ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ لَا يَهۡدِيۡ مَنۡ هُوَ مُسۡرِفٌ كَذَّابٌ
ayahs.tl: Wa qaala rajulum mu'minummin Aali Fir'awna yaktumu eemaanahooo ataqtuloona rajulan ai yaqoola Rabbi yal laahu wa qad jaaa'akum bil haiyinaati mir Rabbikum wa iny yaku kaaziban fa'alaihi kazi buhoo wa iny yaku saadiqany yasibkum ba'dul lazee ya'idukum innal laaha laa yahdee man huwa musrifun kaazaab
ayahs.en: And a believing man from the family of Pharaoh who concealed his faith said, "Do you kill a man [merely] because he says, 'My Lord is Allah' while he has brought you clear proofs from your Lord? And if he should be lying, then upon him is [the consequence of] his lie; but if he should be truthful, there will strike you some of what he promises you. Indeed, Allah does not guide one who is a transgressor and a liar.

ayahs.ar: يٰقَوۡمِ لَكُمُ الۡمُلۡكُ الۡيَوۡمَ ظٰهِرِيۡنَ فِي الۡاَرۡضِؗ فَمَنۡ يَّنۡصُرُنَا مِنۭۡ بَاۡسِ اللّٰهِ اِنۡ جَآءَنَاؕ قَالَ فِرۡعَوۡنُ مَا٘ اُرِيۡكُمۡ اِلَّا مَا٘ اَرٰي وَمَا٘ اَهۡدِيۡكُمۡ اِلَّا سَبِيۡلَ الرَّشَادِ
ayahs.tl: Yaa qawmi lakumul mulkul yawma zaahireena fil ardi famai yansurunaa mim baasil laahi in jaaa'anaa; qaala Fir'awnu maaa ureekum illaa maaa araa wa maaa ahdeekum illaa sabeelar Rashaad
ayahs.en: O my people, sovereignty is yours today, [your being] dominant in the land. But who would protect us from the punishment of Allah if it came to us?" Pharaoh said, "I do not show you except what I see, and I do not guide you except to the way of right conduct."

ayahs.ar: وَقَالَ الَّذِيۡ٘ اٰمَنَ يٰقَوۡمِ اِنِّيۡ٘ اَخَافُ عَلَيۡكُمۡ مِّثۡلَ يَوۡمِ الۡاَحۡزَابِۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa qaalal lazee aamana yaa qawmi inneee akhaafu 'alaikum misla yawmil Ahzaab
ayahs.en: And he who believed said, "O my people, indeed I fear for you [a fate] like the day of the companies -

ayahs.ar: مِثۡلَ دَاۡبِ قَوۡمِ نُوۡحٍ وَّعَادٍ وَّثَمُوۡدَ وَالَّذِيۡنَ مِنۭۡ بَعۡدِهِمۡؕ وَمَا اللّٰهُ يُرِيۡدُ ظُلۡمًا لِّلۡعِبَادِ
ayahs.tl: Misla daabi qawmi Noohinw wa 'aadinw wa Samooda wallazeena mim ba'dihim; wa mal laahu yureedu zulmal lil'ibaad
ayahs.en: Like the custom of the people of Noah and of 'Aad and Thamud and those after them. And Allah wants no injustice for [His] servants.

ayahs.ar: وَيٰقَوۡمِ اِنِّيۡ٘ اَخَافُ عَلَيۡكُمۡ يَوۡمَ التَّنَادِۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa yaa qawmi inneee akhaafu 'alaikum yawmat tanaad
ayahs.en: And O my people, indeed I fear for you the Day of Calling -

ayahs.ar: يَوۡمَ تُوَلُّوۡنَ مُدۡبِرِيۡنَۚ مَا لَكُمۡ مِّنَ اللّٰهِ مِنۡ عَاصِمٍۚ وَمَنۡ يُّضۡلِلِ اللّٰهُ فَمَا لَهٗ مِنۡ هَادٍ
ayahs.tl: Yawma tuwalloona mud bireena maa lakum minal laahi min 'aasim; wa mai yudlilil laahu famaa lahoo min haad
ayahs.en: The Day you will turn your backs fleeing; there is not for you from Allah any protector. And whoever Allah leaves astray - there is not for him any guide.

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدۡ جَآءَكُمۡ يُوۡسُفُ مِنۡ قَبۡلُ بِالۡبَيِّنٰتِ فَمَا زِلۡتُمۡ فِيۡ شَكٍّ مِّمَّا جَآءَكُمۡ بِهٖؕ حَتّٰ٘ي اِذَا هَلَكَ قُلۡتُمۡ لَنۡ يَّبۡعَثَ اللّٰهُ مِنۭۡ بَعۡدِهٖ رَسُوۡلًاؕ كَذٰلِكَ يُضِلُّ اللّٰهُ مَنۡ هُوَ مُسۡرِفٌ مُّرۡتَابُۚۖ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa laqad jaaa'akum Yoosufu min qablu bil baiyinaati famaa ziltum fee shakkim mimaa jaaa'akum bihee hattaaa izaa halaka qultum lai yab asal laahu mim ba'dihee Rasoolaa; kazaalika yudillul laahu man huwa Musrifum murtaab
ayahs.en: And Joseph had already come to you before with clear proofs, but you remained in doubt of that which he brought to you, until when he died, you said, 'Never will Allah send a messenger after him.' Thus does Allah leave astray he who is a transgressor and skeptic."

ayahs.ar: اِۨلَّذِيۡنَ يُجَادِلُوۡنَ فِيۡ٘ اٰيٰتِ اللّٰهِ بِغَيۡرِ سُلۡطٰنٍ اَتٰىهُمۡؕ كَبُرَ مَقۡتًا عِنۡدَ اللّٰهِ وَعِنۡدَ الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡاؕ كَذٰلِكَ يَطۡبَعُ اللّٰهُ عَلٰي كُلِّ قَلۡبِ مُتَكَبِّرٍ جَبَّارٍ
ayahs.tl: Allazeena yujaadiloona feee Aaayaatil laahi bighairi sultaanin ataahum kabura maqtan 'indal laahi wa 'indal lazeena aamanoo; kazaalika yatha'ul laahu 'alaa kulli qalbi mutakabbirin jabbaar
ayahs.en: Those who dispute concerning the signs of Allah without an authority having come to them - great is hatred [of them] in the sight of Allah and in the sight of those who have believed. Thus does Allah seal over every heart [belonging to] an arrogant tyrant.

ayahs.ar: وَقَالَ فِرۡعَوۡنُ يٰهَامٰنُ ابۡنِ لِيۡ صَرۡحًا لَّعَلِّيۡ٘ اَبۡلُغُ الۡاَسۡبَابَۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa qaala Fir'awnu yaa Haamaanub-ni lee sarhal la'alleee ablughul asbaab
ayahs.en: And Pharaoh said, "O Haman, construct for me a tower that I might reach the ways -

ayahs.ar: اَسۡبَابَ السَّمٰوٰتِ فَاَطَّلِعَ اِلٰ٘ي اِلٰهِ مُوۡسٰي وَاِنِّيۡ لَاَظُنُّهٗ كَاذِبًاؕ وَكَذٰلِكَ زُيِّنَ لِفِرۡعَوۡنَ سُوۡٓءُ عَمَلِهٖ وَصُدَّ عَنِ السَّبِيۡلِؕ وَمَا كَيۡدُ فِرۡعَوۡنَ اِلَّا فِيۡ تَبَابٍࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Asbaabas samaawaati faattali'a ilaaa ilaahi Moosaa wa innee la azunnuhoo kaazibaa; wa kazaalika zuyyina li-Fir'awna sooo'u 'amalihee wa sudda 'anis sabeel; wa maa kaidu Fir'awna illaa fee tabaab
ayahs.en: The ways into the heavens - so that I may look at the deity of Moses; but indeed, I think he is a liar." And thus was made attractive to Pharaoh the evil of his deed, and he was averted from the [right] way. And the plan of Pharaoh was not except in ruin.

ayahs.ar: وَقَالَ الَّذِيۡ٘ اٰمَنَ يٰقَوۡمِ اتَّبِعُوۡنِ اَهۡدِكُمۡ سَبِيۡلَ الرَّشَادِۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa qaalal lazeee aamana yaa qawmit tabi'ooni ahdikum sabeelar rashaad
ayahs.en: And he who believed said, "O my people, follow me, I will guide you to the way of right conduct.

ayahs.ar: يٰقَوۡمِ اِنَّمَا هٰذِهِ الۡحَيٰوةُ الدُّنۡيَا مَتَاعٌؗ وَّاِنَّ الۡاٰخِرَةَ هِيَ دَارُ الۡقَرَارِ
ayahs.tl: Yaa qawmi innamaa haazihil hayaatud dunyaa mataa'unw wa innal Aakhirata hiya daarul qaraar
ayahs.en: O my people, this worldly life is only [temporary] enjoyment, and indeed, the Hereafter - that is the home of [permanent] settlement.

ayahs.ar: مَنۡ عَمِلَ سَيِّئَةً فَلَا يُجۡزٰ٘ي اِلَّا مِثۡلَهَاۚ وَمَنۡ عَمِلَ صَالِحًا مِّنۡ ذَكَرٍ اَوۡ اُنۡثٰي وَهُوَ مُؤۡمِنٌ فَاُولٰٓئِكَ يَدۡخُلُوۡنَ الۡجَنَّةَ يُرۡزَقُوۡنَ فِيۡهَا بِغَيۡرِ حِسَابٍ
ayahs.tl: Man 'amila saiyi'atan falaa yujzaaa illaa mislahaa wa man 'amila saaliham min zakarin aw unsaa wa huwa mu'minun fa ulaaa'ika yadkhuloonal Jannata yurzaqoona feehaa bighairi hisaab
ayahs.en: Whoever does an evil deed will not be recompensed except by the like thereof; but whoever does righteousness, whether male or female, while he is a believer - those will enter Paradise, being given provision therein without account.

ayahs.ar: وَيٰقَوۡمِ مَا لِيۡ٘ اَدۡعُوۡكُمۡ اِلَي النَّجٰوةِ وَتَدۡعُوۡنَنِيۡ٘ اِلَي النَّارِؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa yaa qawmi maa leee ad'ookum ilan najaati wa tad'oonaneee ilan Naar
ayahs.en: And O my people, how is it that I invite you to salvation while you invite me to the Fire?

ayahs.ar: تَدۡعُوۡنَنِيۡ لِاَكۡفُرَ بِاللّٰهِ وَاُشۡرِكَ بِهٖ مَا لَيۡسَ لِيۡ بِهٖ عِلۡمٌؗ وَّاَنَا اَدۡعُوۡكُمۡ اِلَي الۡعَزِيۡزِ الۡغَفَّارِ
ayahs.tl: Tad'oonanee li-akfura billaahi wa ushrika bihee maa laisa lee bihee 'ilmunw wa ana ad'ookum ilal'Azeezil Ghaffaar
ayahs.en: You invite me to disbelieve in Allah and associate with Him that of which I have no knowledge, and I invite you to the Exalted in Might, the Perpetual Forgiver.

ayahs.ar: لَا جَرَمَ اَنَّمَا تَدۡعُوۡنَنِيۡ٘ اِلَيۡهِ لَيۡسَ لَهٗ دَعۡوَةٌ فِي الدُّنۡيَا وَلَا فِي الۡاٰخِرَةِ وَاَنَّ مَرَدَّنَا٘ اِلَي اللّٰهِ وَاَنَّ الۡمُسۡرِفِيۡنَ هُمۡ اَصۡحٰبُ النَّارِ
ayahs.tl: Laa jarama annamaa tad'oonanee ilaihi laisa lahoo da'watun fid dunyaa wa laa fil Aakhirati wa anna maraddanaaa ilal laahi wa annal musrifeenahum Ashaabun Naar
ayahs.en: Assuredly, that to which you invite me has no [response to a] supplication in this world or in the Hereafter; and indeed, our return is to Allah, and indeed, the transgressors will be companions of the Fire.

ayahs.ar: فَسَتَذۡكُرُوۡنَ مَا٘ اَقُوۡلُ لَكُمۡؕ وَاُفَوِّضُ اَمۡرِيۡ٘ اِلَي اللّٰهِؕ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ بَصِيۡرٌۭ بِالۡعِبَادِ
ayahs.tl: Fasatazkuroona maaa aqoolu lakum; wa ufawwidu amreee ilal laah; innallaaha baseerum bil'ibaad
ayahs.en: And you will remember what I [now] say to you, and I entrust my affair to Allah. Indeed, Allah is Seeing of [His] servants."

ayahs.ar: فَوَقٰىهُ اللّٰهُ سَيِّاٰتِ مَا مَكَرُوۡا وَحَاقَ بِاٰلِ فِرۡعَوۡنَ سُوۡٓءُ الۡعَذَابِۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Fa waqaahul laahu saiyiaati maa makaroo wa haaqa bi Aali-Fir'awna sooo'ul 'azaab
ayahs.en: So Allah protected him from the evils they plotted, and the people of Pharaoh were enveloped by the worst of punishment -

ayahs.ar: اَلنَّارُ يُعۡرَضُوۡنَ عَلَيۡهَا غُدُوًّا وَّعَشِيًّاۚ وَيَوۡمَ تَقُوۡمُ السَّاعَةُࣞ اَدۡخِلُوۡ٘ا اٰلَ فِرۡعَوۡنَ اَشَدَّ الۡعَذَابِ
ayahs.tl: An Naaru yu'radoona 'alaihaa ghuduwwanw wa 'ashiyyanw wa Yawma taqoomus Saa'aatu adkhilooo Aala Fir'awna ashaddal 'azaab
ayahs.en: The Fire, they are exposed to it morning and evening. And the Day the Hour appears [it will be said], "Make the people of Pharaoh enter the severest punishment."

ayahs.ar: وَاِذۡ يَتَحَآجُّوۡنَ فِي النَّارِ فَيَقُوۡلُ الضُّعَفٰٓؤُا لِلَّذِيۡنَ اسۡتَكۡبَرُوۡ٘ا اِنَّا كُنَّا لَكُمۡ تَبَعًا فَهَلۡ اَنۡتُمۡ مُّغۡنُوۡنَ عَنَّا نَصِيۡبًا مِّنَ النَّارِ
ayahs.tl: Wa iz yatahaaajjoona fin Naari fa-yaqoolud du'afaaa'u lillazeenas takbarooo innaa kunnaa lakum taba'an fahal antum mughnoona annaa naseebam minan Naar
ayahs.en: And [mention] when they will argue within the Fire, and the weak will say to those who had been arrogant, "Indeed, we were [only] your followers, so will you relieve us of a share of the Fire?"

ayahs.ar: قَالَ الَّذِيۡنَ اسۡتَكۡبَرُوۡ٘ا اِنَّا كُلٌّ فِيۡهَا٘ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ قَدۡ حَكَمَ بَيۡنَ الۡعِبَادِ
ayahs.tl: Qaalal lazeenas takbarooo innaa kullun feehaaa innal laaha qad hakama baynal'ibaad
ayahs.en: Those who had been arrogant will say, "Indeed, all [of us] are in it. Indeed, Allah has judged between the servants."

ayahs.ar: وَقَالَ الَّذِيۡنَ فِي النَّارِ لِخَزَنَةِ جَهَنَّمَ ادۡعُوۡا رَبَّكُمۡ يُخَفِّفۡ عَنَّا يَوۡمًا مِّنَ الۡعَذَابِ
ayahs.tl: Wa qaalal lazena fin Naari likhazanati Jahannamad-'oo Rabbakum yukhaffif 'annaa yawmam minal 'azaab
ayahs.en: And those in the Fire will say to the keepers of Hell, "Supplicate your Lord to lighten for us a day from the punishment."

ayahs.ar: قَالُوۡ٘ا اَوَلَمۡ تَكُ تَاۡتِيۡكُمۡ رُسُلُكُمۡ بِالۡبَيِّنٰتِؕ قَالُوۡا بَلٰيؕ قَالُوۡا فَادۡعُوۡاۚ وَمَا دُعٰٓؤُا الۡكٰفِرِيۡنَ اِلَّا فِيۡ ضَلٰلٍࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Qaalooo awalam taku taateekum Rusulukum bilbaiyinaati qaaloo balaa' qaaloo fad'oo; wa maa du'aaa'ul kaafireena illaa fee dalaal
ayahs.en: They will say, "Did there not come to you your messengers with clear proofs?" They will say, "Yes." They will reply, "Then supplicate [yourselves], but the supplication of the disbelievers is not except in error."

ayahs.ar: اِنَّا لَنَنۡصُرُ رُسُلَنَا وَالَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا فِي الۡحَيٰوةِ الدُّنۡيَا وَيَوۡمَ يَقُوۡمُ الۡاَشۡهَادُۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Innaa lanansuru Rusulanaa wallazeena aamanoo fil hayaatid dunyaa wa Yawma yaqoomul ashhaad
ayahs.en: Indeed, We will support Our messengers and those who believe during the life of this world and on the Day when the witnesses will stand -

ayahs.ar: يَوۡمَ لَا يَنۡفَعُ الظّٰلِمِيۡنَ مَعۡذِرَتُهُمۡ وَلَهُمُ اللَّعۡنَةُ وَلَهُمۡ سُوۡٓءُ الدَّارِ
ayahs.tl: Yawma laa yanfa'uz zaalimeena ma'ziratuhum wa lahumul la'natu wa lahum soooud daar
ayahs.en: The Day their excuse will not benefit the wrongdoers, and they will have the curse, and they will have the worst home.

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدۡ اٰتَيۡنَا مُوۡسَي الۡهُدٰي وَاَوۡرَثۡنَا بَنِيۡ٘ اِسۡرَآءِيۡلَ الۡكِتٰبَۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa laqad aatainaa Moosal hudaa wa awrasnaa Baneee Israaa 'eelal Kitaab
ayahs.en: And We had certainly given Moses guidance, and We caused the Children of Israel to inherit the Scripture

ayahs.ar: هُدًي وَّذِكۡرٰي لِاُولِي الۡاَلۡبَابِ
ayahs.tl: Hudanw wa zikraa li ulil albaab
ayahs.en: As guidance and a reminder for those of understanding.

ayahs.ar: فَاصۡبِرۡ اِنَّ وَعۡدَ اللّٰهِ حَقٌّ وَّاسۡتَغۡفِرۡ لِذَنۭۡ بِكَ وَسَبِّحۡ بِحَمۡدِ رَبِّكَ بِالۡعَشِيِّ وَالۡاِبۡكَارِ
ayahs.tl: Fasbir inna wa'dal laahi haqqunw wastaghfir lizambika wa sabbih bihamdi Rabbika bil'ashiyyi wal ibkaar
ayahs.en: So be patient, [O Muhammad]. Indeed, the promise of Allah is truth. And ask forgiveness for your sin and exalt [Allah] with praise of your Lord in the evening and the morning.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّ الَّذِيۡنَ يُجَادِلُوۡنَ فِيۡ٘ اٰيٰتِ اللّٰهِ بِغَيۡرِ سُلۡطٰنٍ اَتٰىهُمۡۙ اِنۡ فِيۡ صُدُوۡرِهِمۡ اِلَّا كِبۡرٌ مَّا هُمۡ بِبَالِغِيۡهِۚ فَاسۡتَعِذۡ بِاللّٰهِؕ اِنَّهٗ هُوَ السَّمِيۡعُ الۡبَصِيۡرُ
ayahs.tl: Innal lazeena yujaadi loona feee Aayaatil laahi bighairi sultaanin ataahum in fee sudoorihim illaa kibrum maa hum bibaaligheeh; fasta'iz billaahi innahoo Huwas Samee'ul Baseer
ayahs.en: Indeed, those who dispute concerning the signs of Allah without [any] authority having come to them - there is not within their breasts except pride, [the extent of] which they cannot reach. So seek refuge in Allah. Indeed, it is He who is the Hearing, the Seeing.

ayahs.ar: لَخَلۡقُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضِ اَكۡبَرُ مِنۡ خَلۡقِ النَّاسِ وَلٰكِنَّ اَكۡثَرَ النَّاسِ لَا يَعۡلَمُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Lakhalqus samaawaati wal ardi akbaru min khalqin naasi wa laakinna aksaran naasi laa ya'lamoon
ayahs.en: The creation of the heavens and earth is greater than the creation of mankind, but most of the people do not know.

ayahs.ar: وَمَا يَسۡتَوِي الۡاَعۡمٰي وَالۡبَصِيۡرُ ࣢ۙ وَالَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ وَلَا الۡمُسِيۡٓءُؕ قَلِيۡلًا مَّا تَتَذَكَّرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa maa yastawil a'maa walbaseeru wallazeena aamanoo wa 'amilus saalihaati wa lal museee'; qaleelam maa tatazakkaroon
ayahs.en: And not equal are the blind and the seeing, nor are those who believe and do righteous deeds and the evildoer. Little do you remember.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّ السَّاعَةَ لَاٰتِيَةٌ لَّا رَيۡبَ فِيۡهَاؗ وَلٰكِنَّ اَكۡثَرَ النَّاسِ لَا يُؤۡمِنُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Innas Saa'ata la aatiyatul laa raiba feehaa wa laakinna aksaran naasi laa yu'minoon
ayahs.en: Indeed, the Hour is coming - no doubt about it - but most of the people do not believe.

ayahs.ar: وَقَالَ رَبُّكُمُ ادۡعُوۡنِيۡ٘ اَسۡتَجِبۡ لَكُمۡؕ اِنَّ الَّذِيۡنَ يَسۡتَكۡبِرُوۡنَ عَنۡ عِبَادَتِيۡ سَيَدۡخُلُوۡنَ جَهَنَّمَ دٰخِرِيۡنَࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa qaala Rabbukumud 'ooneee astajib lakum; innal lazeena yastakbiroona an 'ibaadatee sa yadkhuloona jahannama daakhireen
ayahs.en: And your Lord says, "Call upon Me; I will respond to you." Indeed, those who disdain My worship will enter Hell [rendered] contemptible.

ayahs.ar: اَللّٰهُ الَّذِيۡ جَعَلَ لَكُمُ الَّيۡلَ لِتَسۡكُنُوۡا فِيۡهِ وَالنَّهَارَ مُبۡصِرًاؕ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ لَذُوۡ فَضۡلٍ عَلَي النَّاسِ وَلٰكِنَّ اَكۡثَرَ النَّاسِ لَا يَشۡكُرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Allaahul lazee ja'ala lakumul laila litqaskunoo feehi wannahaara mubsiraa; innal laaha lazoo fadlin 'alan naasi wa laakinna aksaran naasi laa yashkuroon
ayahs.en: It is Allah who made for you the night that you may rest therein and the day giving sight. Indeed, Allah is full of bounty to the people, but most of the people are not grateful.

ayahs.ar: ذٰلِكُمُ اللّٰهُ رَبُّكُمۡ خَالِقُ كُلِّ شَيۡءٍۘ لَا٘ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا هُوَؗ فَاَنّٰي تُؤۡفَكُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Zaalikumul laahu Rabbukum khaaliqu kulli shai'; laaa ilaaha illaa Huwa fa annaa tu'fakoon
ayahs.en: That is Allah, your Lord, Creator of all things; there is no deity except Him, so how are you deluded?

ayahs.ar: كَذٰلِكَ يُؤۡفَكُ الَّذِيۡنَ كَانُوۡا بِاٰيٰتِ اللّٰهِ يَجۡحَدُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Kazaalika yu'fakul loazeena kaanoo bi Aayaatil laahi yajhadoon
ayahs.en: Thus were those [before you] deluded who were rejecting the signs of Allah.

ayahs.ar: اَللّٰهُ الَّذِيۡ جَعَلَ لَكُمُ الۡاَرۡضَ قَرَارًا وَّالسَّمَآءَ بِنَآءً وَّصَوَّرَكُمۡ فَاَحۡسَنَ صُوَرَكُمۡ وَرَزَقَكُمۡ مِّنَ الطَّيِّبٰتِؕ ذٰلِكُمُ اللّٰهُ رَبُّكُمۡۚۖ فَتَبٰرَكَ اللّٰهُ رَبُّ الۡعٰلَمِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Allaahul lazee ja'ala lakumul arda qaraaranw wassa maaa'a binaaa'anw wa sawwarakum fa ahsana suwarakum wa razaqakum minat taiyibaat; zaalikumul laahu Rabbukum fatabaarakal laahu Rabbul 'aalameen
ayahs.en: It is Allah who made for you the earth a place of settlement and the sky a ceiling and formed you and perfected your forms and provided you with good things. That is Allah, your Lord; then blessed is Allah, Lord of the worlds.

ayahs.ar: هُوَ الۡحَيُّ لَا٘ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا هُوَ فَادۡعُوۡهُ مُخۡلِصِيۡنَ لَهُ الدِّيۡنَؕ اَلۡحَمۡدُ لِلّٰهِ رَبِّ الۡعٰلَمِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Huwal Hayyu laaa ilaaha illaa Huwa fad'oohu mukh liseena lahudeen; alhamdu lillaahi Rabbil 'aalameen
ayahs.en: He is the Ever-Living; there is no deity except Him, so call upon Him, [being] sincere to Him in religion. [All] praise is [due] to Allah, Lord of the worlds.

ayahs.ar: قُلۡ اِنِّيۡ نُهِيۡتُ اَنۡ اَعۡبُدَ الَّذِيۡنَ تَدۡعُوۡنَ مِنۡ دُوۡنِ اللّٰهِ لَمَّا جَآءَنِيَ الۡبَيِّنٰتُ مِنۡ رَّبِّيۡؗ وَاُمِرۡتُ اَنۡ اُسۡلِمَ لِرَبِّ الۡعٰلَمِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qul innee nuheetu an a'budal lazeena tad'oona min doonil laahi lammaa jaaa'a niyal biyinaatu mir Rabbee wa umirtu an uslima li Rabbil 'aalameen
ayahs.en: Say, [O Muhammad], "Indeed, I have been forbidden to worship those you call upon besides Allah once the clear proofs have come to me from my Lord, and I have been commanded to submit to the Lord of the worlds."

ayahs.ar: هُوَ الَّذِيۡ خَلَقَكُمۡ مِّنۡ تُرَابٍ ثُمَّ مِنۡ نُّطۡفَةٍ ثُمَّ مِنۡ عَلَقَةٍ ثُمَّ يُخۡرِجُكُمۡ طِفۡلًا ثُمَّ لِتَبۡلُغُوۡ٘ا اَشُدَّكُمۡ ثُمَّ لِتَكُوۡنُوۡا شُيُوۡخًاۚ وَمِنۡكُمۡ مَّنۡ يُّتَوَفّٰي مِنۡ قَبۡلُ وَلِتَبۡلُغُوۡ٘ا اَجَلًا مُّسَمًّي وَّلَعَلَّكُمۡ تَعۡقِلُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Huwal lazee khalaqakum min turaabin summa min nutfatin summa min 'alaqatin summa yukhrijukum tiflan summa litablughooo ashuddakum summa litakoonoo shuyookhaa; wa minkum mai yutawaffaa min qablu wa litablughooo ajalam musam manw-wa la'allakum ta'qiloon
ayahs.en: It is He who created you from dust, then from a sperm-drop, then from a clinging clot; then He brings you out as a child; then [He develops you] that you reach your [time of] maturity, then [further] that you become elders. And among you is he who is taken in death before [that], so that you reach a specified term; and perhaps you will use reason.

ayahs.ar: هُوَ الَّذِيۡ يُحۡيٖ وَيُمِيۡتُۚ فَاِذَا قَضٰ٘ي اَمۡرًا فَاِنَّمَا يَقُوۡلُ لَهٗ كُنۡ فَيَكُوۡنُࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Huwal lazee yuhyee wa yumeetu fa izaa qadaaa amran fa innamaa yaqoolu lahoo kun fa yakon
ayahs.en: He it is who gives life and causes death; and when He decrees a matter, He but says to it, "Be," and it is.

ayahs.ar: اَلَمۡ تَرَ اِلَي الَّذِيۡنَ يُجَادِلُوۡنَ فِيۡ٘ اٰيٰتِ اللّٰهِؕ اَنّٰي يُصۡرَفُوۡنَۙۛ‏
ayahs.tl: Alam tara ilal lazeena yujaadiloona feee Aayaatil laahi annaa yusrafoon
ayahs.en: Do you not consider those who dispute concerning the signs of Allah - how are they averted?

ayahs.ar: الَّذِيۡنَ كَذَّبُوۡا بِالۡكِتٰبِ وَبِمَا٘ اَرۡسَلۡنَا بِهٖ رُسُلَنَاࣞۛ فَسَوۡفَ يَعۡلَمُوۡنَۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Allazeena kazzaboo bil Kitaabi wa bimaa arsalnaa bihee Rusulanaa fasawfa ya'lamoon
ayahs.en: Those who deny the Book and that with which We sent Our messengers - they are going to know,

ayahs.ar: اِذِ الۡاَغۡلٰلُ فِيۡ٘ اَعۡنَاقِهِمۡ وَالسَّلٰسِلُؕ يُسۡحَبُوۡنَۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Izil aghlaalu feee a'naaqi-him wassalaasilu yashaboon
ayahs.en: When the shackles are around their necks and the chains; they will be dragged

ayahs.ar: فِي الۡحَمِيۡمِ ࣢ۙ ثُمَّ فِي النَّارِ يُسۡجَرُوۡنَۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Fil hameemi summa fin Naari Yasjaroon
ayahs.en: In boiling water; then in the Fire they will be filled [with flame].

ayahs.ar: ثُمَّ قِيۡلَ لَهُمۡ اَيۡنَ مَا كُنۡتُمۡ تُشۡرِكُوۡنَۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Summaa qeela lahum ayna maa kuntum tushrikoon
ayahs.en: Then it will be said to them, "Where is that which you used to associate [with Him in worship]

ayahs.ar: مِنۡ دُوۡنِ اللّٰهِؕ قَالُوۡا ضَلُّوۡا عَنَّا بَلۡ لَّمۡ نَكُنۡ نَّدۡعُوۡا مِنۡ قَبۡلُ شَيۡـًٔاؕ كَذٰلِكَ يُضِلُّ اللّٰهُ الۡكٰفِرِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Min doonil laahi qaaloo dalloo 'annaa bal lam nakun nad'oo min qablu shai'aa; kazaalika yudillul laahul kaafireen
ayahs.en: Other than Allah?" They will say, "They have departed from us; rather, we did not used to invoke previously anything." Thus does Allah put astray the disbelievers.

ayahs.ar: ذٰلِكُمۡ بِمَا كُنۡتُمۡ تَفۡرَحُوۡنَ فِي الۡاَرۡضِ بِغَيۡرِ الۡحَقِّ وَبِمَا كُنۡتُمۡ تَمۡرَحُوۡنَۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Zaalikum bimaa kuntum tafrahoona fil ardi bighairil haqqi wa bimaa kuntum tamrahoon
ayahs.en: [The angels will say], "That was because you used to exult upon the earth without right and you used to behave insolently.

ayahs.ar: اُدۡخُلُوۡ٘ا اَبۡوَابَ جَهَنَّمَ خٰلِدِيۡنَ فِيۡهَاۚ فَبِئۡسَ مَثۡوَي الۡمُتَكَبِّرِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Udkhulooo abwaaba Jahannama khaalideena feehaa fabi'sa maswal mutakabbireen
ayahs.en: Enter the gates of Hell to abide eternally therein, and wretched is the residence of the arrogant."

ayahs.ar: فَاصۡبِرۡ اِنَّ وَعۡدَ اللّٰهِ حَقٌّۚ فَاِمَّا نُرِيَنَّكَ بَعۡضَ الَّذِيۡ نَعِدُهُمۡ اَوۡ نَتَوَفَّيَنَّكَ فَاِلَيۡنَا يُرۡجَعُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Fasbir inna wa'dal laahi haqq; fa immaa nuriyannak ba'dal lazee na'i duhum aw natawaffayannaka fa ilainaa yurja'oon
ayahs.en: So be patient, [O Muhammad]; indeed, the promise of Allah is truth. And whether We show you some of what We have promised them or We take you in death, it is to Us they will be returned.

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدۡ اَرۡسَلۡنَا رُسُلًا مِّنۡ قَبۡلِكَ مِنۡهُمۡ مَّنۡ قَصَصۡنَا عَلَيۡكَ وَمِنۡهُمۡ مَّنۡ لَّمۡ نَقۡصُصۡ عَلَيۡكَؕ وَمَا كَانَ لِرَسُوۡلٍ اَنۡ يَّاۡتِيَ بِاٰيَةٍ اِلَّا بِاِذۡنِ اللّٰهِۚ فَاِذَا جَآءَ اَمۡرُ اللّٰهِ قُضِيَ بِالۡحَقِّ وَخَسِرَ هُنَالِكَ الۡمُبۡطِلُوۡنَࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa laqad arsalnaa Rusulam min qablika minhum man qasasnaa 'alaika wa minhum mal lam naqsus 'alaik; wa maa kaana li Rasoolin any yaatiya bi Aayatin illaa bi iznil laah; fa izaa jaaa'a amrul laahi qudiya bilhaqqi wa khasira hunaalikal mubtiloon
ayahs.en: And We have already sent messengers before you. Among them are those [whose stories] We have related to you, and among them are those [whose stories] We have not related to you. And it was not for any messenger to bring a sign [or verse] except by permission of Allah. So when the command of Allah comes, it will be concluded in truth, and the falsifiers will thereupon lose [all].

ayahs.ar: اَللّٰهُ الَّذِيۡ جَعَلَ لَكُمُ الۡاَنۡعَامَ لِتَرۡكَبُوۡا مِنۡهَا وَمِنۡهَا تَاۡكُلُوۡنَؗ‏
ayahs.tl: Allaahul lazee ja'ala lakumul an'aama litarkaboo minhaa wa minhaa taakuloon
ayahs.en: It is Allah who made for you the grazing animals upon which you ride, and some of them you eat.

ayahs.ar: وَلَكُمۡ فِيۡهَا مَنَافِعُ وَلِتَبۡلُغُوۡا عَلَيۡهَا حَاجَةً فِيۡ صُدُوۡرِكُمۡ وَعَلَيۡهَا وَعَلَي الۡفُلۡكِ تُحۡمَلُوۡنَؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa lakum feehaa manaafi'u wa litablughoo 'alaihaa haajatan fee sudoorikum wa 'alaihaa wa 'alal fulki tuhmaloon
ayahs.en: And for you therein are [other] benefits and that you may realize upon them a need which is in your breasts; and upon them and upon ships you are carried.

ayahs.ar: وَيُرِيۡكُمۡ اٰيٰتِهٖࣗۖ فَاَيَّ اٰيٰتِ اللّٰهِ تُنۡكِرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa yureekum Aayaatihee fa ayya Aayaatil laahi tunkiroon
ayahs.en: And He shows you His signs. So which of the signs of Allah do you deny?

ayahs.ar: اَفَلَمۡ يَسِيۡرُوۡا فِي الۡاَرۡضِ فَيَنۡظُرُوۡا كَيۡفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الَّذِيۡنَ مِنۡ قَبۡلِهِمۡؕ كَانُوۡ٘ا اَكۡثَرَ مِنۡهُمۡ وَاَشَدَّ قُوَّةً وَّاٰثَارًا فِي الۡاَرۡضِ فَمَا٘ اَغۡنٰي عَنۡهُمۡ مَّا كَانُوۡا يَكۡسِبُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Afalam yaseeroo fil ardi fa yanzuroo kaifa kaana 'aaqibatul lazeena min qablihim; kaanoo aksara minhum wa ashadda quwwatanw wa aasaaran fil ardi famaaa aghnaa 'anhum maa kaanoo yaksiboon
ayahs.en: Have they not traveled through the land and observed how was the end of those before them? They were more numerous than themselves and greater in strength and in impression on the land, but they were not availed by what they used to earn.

ayahs.ar: فَلَمَّا جَآءَتۡهُمۡ رُسُلُهُمۡ بِالۡبَيِّنٰتِ فَرِحُوۡا بِمَا عِنۡدَهُمۡ مِّنَ الۡعِلۡمِ وَحَاقَ بِهِمۡ مَّا كَانُوۡا بِهٖ يَسۡتَهۡزِءُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Falammaa jaaa'at hum Rusuluhum bilbaiyinaati farihoo bimaa 'indahum minal 'ilmi wa haaqa bihim maa kaanoo bihee yastahzi'oon
ayahs.en: And when their messengers came to them with clear proofs, they [merely] rejoiced in what they had of knowledge, but they were enveloped by what they used to ridicule.

ayahs.ar: فَلَمَّا رَاَوۡا بَاۡسَنَا قَالُوۡ٘ا اٰمَنَّا بِاللّٰهِ وَحۡدَهٗ وَكَفَرۡنَا بِمَا كُنَّا بِهٖ مُشۡرِكِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Falammaa ra aw baasanaa qaalooo aamannaa billaahi wahdahoo wa kafarnaa bimaa kunnaa bihee mushrikeen
ayahs.en: And when they saw Our punishment, they said," We believe in Allah alone and disbelieve in that which we used to associate with Him."

ayahs.ar: فَلَمۡ يَكُ يَنۡفَعُهُمۡ اِيۡمَانُهُمۡ لَمَّا رَاَوۡا بَاۡسَنَاؕ سُنَّتَ اللّٰهِ الَّتِيۡ قَدۡ خَلَتۡ فِيۡ عِبَادِهٖۚ وَخَسِرَ هُنَالِكَ الۡكٰفِرُوۡنَࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Falam yaku tanfa 'uhum eemaanuhum lammaa ra-aw baasana sunnatal laahil latee qad khalat fee 'ibaadihee wa khasira hunaalikal kaafiroon
ayahs.en: But never did their faith benefit them once they saw Our punishment. [It is] the established way of Allah which has preceded among His servants. And the disbelievers thereupon lost [all].
